products.title: Jefftron V3 Mosfet
products.body_html:
This Jefftron V3 mosfet is designed to increase gun rate of fire, and battery will hold longer compared to basic wiring. It is fully integrated inside the gearbox version 3 instead of the original trigger contacts, and is compatible with Tokyo Marui standard.

Why Do I Need A Mosfet? | What Do They Do?

SPECIFICATIONS 

- Mosfet build on trigger contacts from SHS company
- Easy installation inside the gearbox version 3
- Presoldered wires allows faster and easier installation into the gun, it is long enough for all kind of weapons. Simply cut wires to the required length and attach connectors (included in package)
- On the devices are presoldered high quality 2 black wires 1,5 qmm (AWG16) with MPPE insulation, length 400 mm to the motor and 600 mm to the battery. The blue wire 0.34 qmm (AWG22) with a length 1000 mm is used for connection anywhere on the red cable
- In package is included 1000 mm red wire 1,5qmm (AWG16) with MPPE insulation
- Board covered by conformal coating, it protect device against water
- If you want to use your own wires, choose device without wiring
- Designed for spring up to M160 (equivalent for current 75A single shot fire or 25A burst fire for max. 30s). For higher load please use Mosfet II (it is outside gearbox)
- Specified for common batteries up to 17V (Ni-xx 8.4 - 12V, lipol 7.4 - 14.8V)
- No current consumption in the idle mode
- No sparking on switch contacts
- In auto fire mode piston stops in random position due the mechabox design
- For right function is necessary to have a functional gearbox cut off lever, selector plate, reverse latch, trigger and trigger block, as it has the standard gearbox

DEVICE INSTRUCTIONS

You can download installation manual in English here 

PACKING

- Mosfet on trigger contacts with wiring
- Trigger switch
- DeanT connector male
- 30A Mini fuse
- 4x Faston female 2,8mm
- 6x Black heat shrink tube 3,2mm - length 20mm
- 3x Black heat shrink tube 4,8mm - length 20mm
- Installation manual in English

products.title: Universal APACHE Tappetless Cylinder Head/ Nozzle
products.body_html:
How does a perfect seal and no tappet plate or return spring sound?

Well to Aztech Innovations it sounded pretty damn amazing.

Here it is, the APACHE!  The first of its kind in the world, all air controlled driven by the piston. 

-No mechanical forks or prongs to retract the nozzles
-No timing issues
-No broken return springs 
-No broken tappet plates and best of all no fps droop on high rate of fire.

The all in one sealed cylinder head ensures perfect seal for max air flow and zero air loss with out any mechanical gear driven parts to create issues.

The APACHE produces extremely consistent high pressure air flow seen as a huge improvement in consistency of feet per second plus a noticeable improvement in accuracy thanks to reduced turbulence of the airflow through the tri port and past the aerodynamic "boat tail'' internal nozzle, combined these streamline the airflow into the barrel and behind the gel, pushing the gel in a single uniform flow for max power.

Please note, using an APACHE DOES NOT increase the volume of your cylinder.  The APACHE doesn't open be able to increase volume, it opens when cylinder pressure increases through the piston moving forward, then the air moves from the Cylinder forward into the APACHE, the volume doesn't increase as it opens it moves.

Compatability

- Universal on all Gel Blasters

products.title: DNA MCU - V2 Mosfet (Wolverine HPA Engine)
products.body_html:
The “DNA MCU” (Magazine Control Unit) by Double Dippa Designs, is designed for use with all variants of the Wolverine Inferno HPA Engines FCU’s.

The “DNA MCU” fixes the issue of having constant power going to the magazine, and makes it so the magazine only receives power when the trigger is pulled.
By using the included ‘Y’ connector, both the FCU and MCU can be powered by a single 2S (7.4V) battery. And for high R.O.F. builds 2 batteries can be used, a 2S (7.4V) to power the Wolverine Inferno FCU and a 3S or 4S (11.1V or 14.8V) to power the MCU which in turn will give the magazine either 11.1V or 14.8V making it feed faster.

Finally, the Trijicon SRS features dual power sources — an innovative solar cell assisted by a single AA battery.

products.title: GBU Custom Series "NANO" Adjustable HPA/ Mosfet CNC Trigger
products.body_html:

These HPA triggers are 4mm shorter than our standard HPA triggers to give a different style of gameplay and possibly a slight advantage for comfortability.

These triggers are adjustable at 2 points to allow a stopper to prevent over pulling and a sensitiser to allow minimal travel distance for sensitive trigger response.

GBU Adjustable Trigger Overview
How-To Guide

Compatibility

- Polarstar F2 HPA Engines
- Wolverine Inferno HPA Engines

(These triggers may or may not need to be modified to suite AEG blasters with mosfets)

These triggers are strictly HPA/ Mosfet Triggers, they will not work in V2 gearboxes that do not contain mosfets.

products.title: Polarstar F2 - HPA Engine
products.body_html:
Bite Sized Fusion Engine

Winner of the "Best HPA Engine" in the 9th Airsoft Players Choice Awards, the dual solenoid design of the F2™ provides the same functionality as the legendary Fusion Engine™ but in a more compact, efficient and flexible design.

Dual solenoids allow for the nozzle and the poppet valve to be adjusted independently of each other for unparalleled control over both the loading time and air volume used. Additionally, this makes it possible to change the firing sequence giving it the ability to operate in both true closed bolt as well as "AEG" mode.

Note

These engines have mag terminal wires inside package.

products.title: SHS Gear Sets
products.body_html:
Genuine SHS carbon steel gear set. High grade steel and the perfect upgrade for your internal gearbox.

If you have kept an eye out over the past 2 years, there has been so many different SHS gear types. To ensure you are getting genuine gears, look under the SECTOR GEAR, the round holes should be CNC and taper in, as fake gear sets will have a flat base underneath and of course the most obvious key is that they will not last you more than a game or so.

Cast Metal vs. SHS Metal Gears
